title: Jewel Toned Russian Plum Pilaf
description: A rich and flavorful one-pot dish featuring plum jam and lamination-puff, served on a wooden board. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread the plum jam evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the jam to form a crust.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the rice to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water, salt, and pepper to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Place the pastry on a wooden board and spoon the rice mixture into the center of the pastry.
Fold the pastry up over the rice to form a packet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
